metric_space: native canonical Q8 RGB codes 0..255; float64 mean squared code errors over RGB channels/pixels within each case

definitions.E: MSE(predicted query output, known-treatment query output)

aggregation: Equal cases within group; equal donor and query contribution under balanced grid. Never concatenate different-sized images across cases.

gates.controls: Each constant and shuffled-C pooled error must exceed learned error by strictly more than 0.1D

sign_tests.unit: donor mean over matched treatments and four queries

gates.roi: For each named mask, pool equal cases over references/treatments then require E<=0.25D; conjunction across masks; D=0 requires E=0
gates.saturation: Eligible source channel codes1..254. Per case count predicted endpoint channels minus ideal-treatment endpoint channels; require200*excess<=eligible. No cross-case averaging.
gates.zero_eligible_saturation: Report not applicable, fractions null, integer inequality0<=0; never claim preserved absent eligible detail.

validation.mse: Equal-weight four standardized target coordinates then equal donor/treatment cases
validation.pass: Learned MSE <=0.8*constant MSE; zero constant MSE is degenerate stop
